title: Season One: The Curse
arc: Channel 47 is about to cancel Hank's show and stopped paying him in January; a storm Cody keeps seeing is coming; and the Hardwicks are coming apart. Anna keeps leaving to do things for them and missing the moments that matter; Maya's mouth costs her a job, a class and nearly a sister; Jet's crypto rig and one repeated password pull a scam to the door; Dusty, the cool guy, has been living in his car on their street; Dale is offered a show for the generation he can't stand; and Krystal is quietly paying for all of it. Through it Hank builds the dome a ring at a time, and every week the family reprograms it into what the disaster needs. In the finale the storm takes the roof, the dome is the only thing standing, and all of them are inside it, still arguing.

threads.name: The curse
threads.about: Every episode, one improbable misfortune. The family keeps a tally on the fridge. It is a joke until it isn't.

threads.name: The storm
threads.about: Cody's visions of a dome standing alone in a storm. Each vision shows a little more, and in E9 the forecast catches up.

threads.name: Channel 47
threads.about: Hank's Hardware Hour is losing to a teenager's TikTok. The station wants him out; Dale is being courted to host something 'younger'.

threads.name: Anna's road
threads.about: Anna plans to leave on a long road trip with Dusty. She keeps missing the family moments, and the family keeps not noticing until it is too late. She learns where home is.

threads.name: Maya's mouth
threads.about: Maya loses the hardware-store job for saying the true thing out loud, then nearly loses Cody's trust. She learns when to keep the side-eye and when to speak.

threads.name: Jet's hustle
threads.about: Burner phones, a mining rig in the dome, a debt to people online who know the address. The earring keeps coming and going. Hank never lectures him; he hands him a saw.

threads.name: Krystal's foot
threads.about: The silly one who becomes the head of the house when it counts. She is carrying more than anyone knows: the bills.

threads.name: Dale vs. the youth
threads.about: Dale can't stand Jet's generation and is offered a show built for it. He ends up the only adult Jet listens to.

threads.name: The dome's programs
threads.about: The dome's state from the frame to the finished shelter: it goes up a ring or two each episode and becomes something different each time.

episodes.title: Half the Fold
episodes.logline: Anna announces she's leaving with Dusty, the station threatens Hank's show, and Hank's first dome ring comes out wrong. Krystal puts her foot down: nobody leaves until it stands.

plots.A: Hank's crooked first ring, the thought spiral that finds the error (half the fold), and the night he teaches Jet and Cody the jig.
plots.B: Anna's announcement; she misses the family dinner where the decision is made.
plots.C: Maya's side-eye at a customer costs her the store job; Jet hides a new piercing.

episodes.dome_program: a frame: the family argues about what it is for
episodes.hidden_lesson: Two panels meet at a fold, and each gives half of it.

threads.curse: The deck collapses on taping day.
threads.storm: First vision: a dome alone in a storm.

episodes.cliffhanger: Cody sees the storm again, closer.
episodes.moral: You don't hold a joint by squeezing it; each side gives half.

episodes.title: Load Path
episodes.logline: Jet turns the half-built dome into a crypto mining room and blacks out the street on the one hot night. Hank doesn't tell him he's wrong; he asks him where the load goes.

plots.A: Jet's rigs, the blackout, and the push that teaches him the load path; Hank sends the rig to the garage.
plots.B: Dale's agent pitches a show for 'the youth'; Jet catches him tempted.
plots.C: Maya's video interviews, each ended by her face; Krystal hides the mail.

episodes.hidden_lesson: Every load finds a path to the ground; triangles give it six.

threads.curse: Blackout on the one hot night.

episodes.cliffhanger: The car outside is still there at 3 a.m.
devices: dramatic irony: Krystal and the bills
Chekhov: the rig in the garage
callback: 'that's what they want you to think'
episodes.moral: When something is too much for you, give it more than one way down: share the load.

episodes.title: Frequency
episodes.logline: Krystal babysits Mr. Yarrow's four-year-old, Bean, who builds a rounder dome out of straws than Hank's crew can out of wood. Maya is suspended for being right at a teacher.

plots.A: Bean's straw dome and Hank's spiral on resolution and patience.
plots.C: Anna's video call freezes on the one night everything happens; Dale learns slang at five dollars a word.

episodes.hidden_lesson: More, smaller triangles make a rounder dome: frequency is resolution.

threads.dome: The skin goes on the first section.
threads.curse: A raccoon moves into the frame.

devices: foil: the toddler and the crew
juxtaposition: Bean praised and Maya punished for the same honesty
episodes.moral: Being right is half of it. Saying it so the other person can hear it is the other half.

episodes.title: Play House
episodes.logline: Anna and Dusty come home early and turn the dome into a pink influencer set. Maya works out where Dusty sleeps and says it at dinner. Cody sees Dusty running from a fire. Dusty takes Hank's truck.

plots.A: The set, the sponsor, and the dinner nobody waited for Anna.
plots.B: Maya vs. Dusty; she is right and loses anyway.
plots.C: Cody's vision; Dale films a TikTok so bad it's good.

episodes.hidden_lesson: The same frame can be anybody's house.

threads.maya_mouth: She's right about Dusty and still loses.
threads.curse: A small fire on the set.

devices: irony: Maya right and still wrong
episodes.moral: The truth told to shame someone is still a weapon.

episodes.title: Debugging
episodes.logline: A scammer who knows the address says Jet owes him. Cody's friend Priya wires the dome like a program and explains loops with the jig; Hank's longest spiral finds the bug in Jet's plan. At 3 a.m. somebody knocks.

plots.A: The threat, the password, the bug fixed at the source.
plots.B: Priya teaches loops with the jig.
plots.C: Jet's ear; Krystal finds the earring. The knock is Dusty, bringing back the truck; Anna has gone out looking for him.

episodes.dome_program: a computer: every panel a line of code
episodes.hidden_lesson: A pattern repeated is a loop; a wrong number repeated is a bug, everywhere at once.

threads.jet_hustle: The debt, paid the hard way.
threads.dale_youth: Dale stands between Jet and the door.
threads.anna_leaves: A note on the fridge nobody reads.

devices: dramatic irony: Anna out looking for the man asleep in the garage
episodes.moral: When the same mistake shows up everywhere, fix the pattern, not each place it shows up.

episodes.title: Tension and Compression
episodes.logline: The garage burns with Jet's rig in it and Dusty runs. The family splits over insurance money, and Krystal breaks: there is no money. She has been paying for everything since January, alone.

plots.A: The fire, the night in the frame, the split.
plots.B: Krystal's ledger; she breaks before she plants her foot.
plots.C: Dale at the bar, alone, on the phone; Maya finds Dusty's burned jacket.

episodes.hidden_lesson: Some members pull, some push, and the shape holds because both do.

threads.krystal_foot: She breaks before she plants her foot.
threads.show: The station stopped paying in January.

devices: payoff: the rig, the small fire, the mail
episodes.moral: Notice who is pulling while everyone else is pushing; the shape holds because of both.

episodes.title: The Hub That Isn't There
episodes.logline: Hank's last show goes out live from the dome with the kids as crew. Everything breaks, Dale says goodbye on air, Maya keeps her mouth shut, and Hank's thought spiral happens in front of four million people.

plots.A: The live finale and the viral clip.
plots.C: Maya's chosen silence; Anna, alone at a motel, watches it without her.

episodes.hidden_lesson: Nothing has to sit in the middle for the corners to hold.

threads.anna_leaves: She watches it from a motel.

episodes.cliffhanger: The viral clip shows Cody's storm in the sky behind them.
devices: foreshadowing: the storm in the clip
restraint: the line Maya doesn't say
episodes.moral: Nothing has to sit in the middle for the corners to hold.

episodes.title: Pinwheel
episodes.logline: Maya calls Anna with the truth about Dusty. The family plans a surprise for her return and forgets to tell her. Alone at a motel, Anna works out that she has always been the one who goes, and turns the car around.

plots.B: The surprise that becomes a fight about a banner.
plots.C: Jet takes the earring out for good; Dale gives him a reason to put it back.

episodes.hidden_lesson: In a pinwheel, each piece holds the next one, all the way round.
devices: structure: a pinwheel of scenes, each handing the episode to the next person
episodes.moral: In a pinwheel each piece holds the next one; ask who is holding the one who holds everyone.

episodes.title: The Last Panel
episodes.logline: Storm prep. Jet's paranoia is finally useful, Cody's vision becomes the forecast, Dusty brings every screw the store had, and the panel that broke on the first day goes up last, in the rain.

plots.A: The race to finish against the clock.
plots.B: Jet's bunker; Dusty's screws; Dale holds a ladder while the network calls.
plots.C: Mr. Yarrow refuses to leave his roses; Anna says she'll go and get him.

episodes.hidden_lesson: The whole is stronger than the strongest piece in it.

threads.anna_leaves: She's the one who remembers Mr. Yarrow.
threads.dale_youth: He holds a ladder for the network.
threads.curse: The storm of the century. Of course.
threads.show: The network calls; Dale is holding a ladder.

devices: payoff: the burst panel, the bunker, Maya's old job
callback: 'that's what they want you to think'
episodes.moral: Get ready before you need to, together; the whole is stronger than its strongest piece.

episodes.title: The Storm
episodes.logline: All of them, with Dale, Dusty, Mr. Yarrow and a raccoon, inside the dome while the storm takes the roof off the house. They agree on one thing, and then they don't.

plots.A: The night, and the seam that has to be held.
plots.B: Hank's spiral, which the whole family hears.
plots.C: Dusty, for once, does the brave thing; the network calls at dawn.

episodes.hidden_lesson: Shaped right, the lightest house is the one that stands.

threads.show: A new offer, from the network.
threads.krystal_foot: She lets someone else plant it.
threads.dale_youth: The network wants both of them.
threads.jet_hustle: The bunker keeps nine people alive.

episodes.cliffhanger: Morning: the dome stands alone in a flattened street, and Cody sees something new.
devices: convention broken: the spiral heard aloud
circular ending: the last tally mark, on the door
episodes.moral: Home is the thing everyone holds a piece of.

devices.motif: 'Level with me': each episode someone asks for the truth with those words, and each time the answer costs something.
devices.running: The curse tally on the fridge: one mark an episode, read out as a caption. It is a joke until episode six, and the last mark goes on the dome's door.
devices.red_herring: The car outside at 3 a.m. (E2) is not the men Jet fears. It is Dusty, who lives in it (E4), and who brings Hank's truck back to the same door (E5).
devices.unreliable_vision: Cody's E4 vision shows Dusty running from a fire. In E6 everyone reads it as guilt; in E8 we learn he was running with Jet's rig wrapped in his burned jacket.
devices.dramatic_irony: From E2's tag the audience knows Krystal is alone with the bills; the family learns it in E6.
devices.mirror: E1 ends with Krystal's foot coming down: nobody leaves until it stands. In E10 Anna says the same thing inside the dome while it does.
devices.structure: E8 is built as a pinwheel: each scene hands the episode to the next person, all the way round to Anna. E10 is a bottle episode: one room, one night.
devices.fourth_wall: E7 goes out live: Hank's thought spiral happens on air, and the viral clip carries the storm in the sky behind him.

setups.what: Hank tells Jet to move the mining rig to the garage ('it's an address, not a punishment')
setups.how: The rig starts the garage fire.
Maya works out it is Dusty's, and that he sleeps in it.

setups.what: Krystal: 'Mail is mine. I'm the mail lady.'
setups.how: The ledger: she has paid everything since January.

setups.what: The raccoon that moves into the frame
setups.how: It rides out the storm with them.

setups.what: Krystal's verdict: be right FOR him, not AT him
setups.how: Maya calls Anna to tell her the truth about Dusty, for her.

setups.what: Bean's crayon drawing of the dome alone in a storm
setups.how: Yarrow pins it up inside the dome.

setups.what: A small fire on Anna's pink set ('nobody worries about small fires')
Jet says his password out loud as he types
setups.how: Cody knows it, so the scammer did.

setups.what: The panel that burst on air in the cold open of E1
setups.how: Hank repaired it; it is the last panel, and Dusty sets it.

setups.what: Jet's bunker supplies and burner phones
setups.how: Paranoia, finally useful: radios, water, light.

setups.what: Dusty took Maya's old job at the hardware store
setups.how: He brings every structural screw they had left.
